description: Election Commission - G. R. S. Kumara was selected as the member of the Kalutara Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kalutara Urban Council) due to the death of a member, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member through a political party process, which falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
